name: peaking-save-guard
description: Focus peaking waits while another owner has blocks in the image-work heap. (1) The latch: when the heap is not in mode 1 and the pool of the modes 0 and 2 has a block in use (a photo that is being developed and saved), the latch byte L gets 2 in place of 1: MF Assist magnifies at once, as with Peaking Off, and the lines start in the first frame in which the pool is empty. (2) The heap-mode hook: when peaking ends and the pool of mode 1 still has a block in use, the heap stays in mode 1 until a later call finds the pool empty. Before, the heap was re-divided under those blocks, the art buffers were refused in every frame, and the camera restarted (firmware error 0x34000002, camera log of 2026-11-16). A delta on builds/peaking-fast.json: every expect is a byte string of that build. See experiments/2026-11-14-focus-peaking/NOTES.md section 18.
_ram: no new RAM. L (0x602BE8C4) and its copy L2 can now hold 2 = held by the guard; reads the heap mode 0x605157CC and the two pool objects named at 0x602AC458 / 0x602AC45C

ops._note: new code in place of the row loop of peaking-colours that peaking-fast left without a reader: T_GUARD, T_M2 (97 B)
T_A, after the last stock condition: `inc d1` / `clr d0` / `movbu d0,(4,a1)` -> `jmp T_GUARD`
